accepted.sentence: Its brass tubing forms a long bore that gradually expands into a broad, outward-flaring bell.
A telescoping hand-operated slide changes the tubing length, altering the resonating air column.
The removable mouthpiece has a cup-shaped rim and narrow throat that channels air into the tubing.
Two parallel tubes are joined by a crosspiece, helping keep the moving slide assembly aligned during extension.
A curved brace connects the moving section to the bell section and gives the supporting hand a grip.
A small water key lets accumulated condensation drain through an opening in the slide assembly.
A tuning slide made from nested tubing allows small adjustments to the instrument’s overall length and pitch.
Many models have lacquered or plated brass surfaces, while the inner slide tubes are finished to move smoothly.
